hero.title: Three minutes to look at life with more attention.
hero.subtitle: A daily reflection to pause, think about life, and notice what deserves your attention.

tension.title:
Your day is
already full.
tension.p1: Messages, work, news, decisions, worries. And there's always one more thing.
tension.p2: In the midst of all this, it's easy to spend the whole day reacting to what happens and almost never stop to notice what is happening inside us.

relief.title: That's why three minutes exist.
relief.subtitle: A small space in the day to pause, think, and pay attention to the life that is happening right now.

step3.title: Practice.
step3.desc: Bring the reflection into real life.

quote1.top: A pause can change how you see the day.
quote1.statement:
Life doesn't need more speed.
It needs more attention.

split.title: What guides your sight?
split.p1: The Christian faith is at the heart of 3 Minutes for Life. It invites us to look at our choices, our relationships, our challenges, and our purpose in the light of God and the teachings of Jesus.
split.p2: Not to offer ready-made answers, but to make room for questions that really matter.

audience.title: For those who want to live with more intention.
items: For those who need to slow down.
For those who want to better care for their relationships.
For those who work and lead.
For those who simply need a few minutes to think.

quote2.bottom: More attention to the life you are already living.

sustainability.title: A free project, sustained by people
sustainability.p1: 3 Minutes for Life was born so that anyone can find, every day, a few minutes to pause, reflect, and look at life with more attention.
sustainability.p2: That is why access to the content is free.
sustainability.p3: We don't want the ability to pay to determine who can receive a reflection.
sustainability.p4: The project is sustained by people who believe in this proposal and choose to contribute voluntarily so that it continues to exist, be maintained, and reach more people.
sustainability.p5: You don't have to contribute to use it. Support is voluntary and does not alter access to the content or essential features of 3 Minutes for Life.
sustainability.p6: If, at some point, you feel it is worth helping, you can be part of the project's sustainability.
sustainability.breakdownDesc: Contributions help maintain and develop the project.

q1.a: Yes. Access to the core content is free. The project is sustained by people who choose to support it voluntarily.

q2.q: Do I need to be Christian to use it?
q2.a: No. 3 Minutes for Life starts from a Christian perspective, but it was created to converse with anyone who wants to pause, reflect, and look at life with more attention.

q3.q: How much time do I need per day?
q3.a: The proposal is to take approximately three minutes.

q4.q: Do I need to install an app?
q4.a: The platform works directly in the browser and can be added to the mobile home screen as an app.

q5.q: Is the content generated by AI?
q5.a: No. The content is written and editorially reviewed by people, to preserve a human, simple, and consistent voice.

q6.q: How can I support the project?
q6.a: The content is free. If you want to voluntarily contribute to the continuity and expansion of the project, you can learn about the support options provided by 3 Minutes for Life. Support is not required to access the content.

footer.tagline: Three minutes to look at life with more attention.
